verdict.rationale: PayPal documents in-assistant checkout for ChatGPT, via ACP Instant Checkout with Braintree delegated tokens, and for Google AI Mode/Gemini, via UCP with a Google Pay handler through Braintree. Store Sync separately lets AI agents create carts and complete purchases through conversational interfaces, calling merchant-hosted cart endpoints. The caveats are significant: Agent Ready requires a Braintree account, Store Sync is form-gated and limited to US physical goods in USD, and UCP needs Google enablement. Missing for 10: any evidence covering Claude, Copilot or other named surfaces; self-serve access; support for digital goods and non-US buyers; independent or hands-on confirmation of a completed in-chat purchase.
